definition: Ten immortality resources in the Xiyouji world · scarcity / efficacy / access difficulty / owners · constituting the ‘immortality economy’
scoring_criteria: scarcity/efficacy/access_level all scored 0-10: 10 = most scarce / most effective / hardest to obtain

resources.name: Peach (9000-year tree)
resources.owner: Queen Mother of the West (Peach Orchard · Heaven)
resources.rarity_reason: Ripens every 9000 years · only 9 trees in all · limited fruit per tree · distributed only at the Peach Banquet
resources.effect: As long-lived as heaven and earth · coeval with the sun and moon

resources.name: Ginseng Fruit
resources.rarity_reason: Ripens every 3000 years · only 30 per tree · smelling one gives 360 years · eating one gives 47,000 years
resources.effect: 47,000 years of life · but must not be eaten in excess

resources.name: Taishang Laojun’s Elixir
resources.rarity_reason: Refined personally by Laojun · limited quantity · divided into ‘Golden Elixir / Restorative Elixir / Nine-Turn Golden Elixir’ grades

resources.name: Tang Sanzang’s Flesh
resources.owner: Tang Sanzang (reincarnation of the Golden Cicada · ten lifetimes of cultivation)
resources.rarity_reason: Ten lifetimes of cultivation · primal yang unspent · yin and yang united · the only one in all of Xiyouji
resources.effect: Immortality (legend · never actually verified · every demon failed)

resources.name: Golden Hoop Release
resources.owner: Tathāgata Buddha (three golden hoops · handed over by Guanyin)
resources.rarity_reason: Falls off by itself after attaining Buddhahood · cannot be removed by external force · a reward for ‘project completion’
resources.effect: Release from bondage · gain freedom (falls off after being named Victorious Fighting Buddha)

resources.name: Heavenly River Water
resources.owner: Marshal Tianpeng (Zhu Bajie) · 80,000 naval troops of the Heavenly River
resources.rarity_reason: Water of the Heavenly River · plentiful but requires Heaven’s authorization · invisible in the mortal world
resources.effect: Life extension / healing / purification · not a top-tier immortality resource

resources.name: Zhenyuan Daxian’s Ginseng Fruit (same as ginseng fruit · specifically gifted)
resources.owner: Zhenyuan Daxian (gifted after becoming Wukong’s sworn brother)
resources.rarity_reason: Ripens every 3000 years · 2 of 30 gifted · requires a sworn-brother bond to obtain
resources.effect: 47,000 years of life · carries a ‘personal favor’ attribute · cannot be traded

resources.name: Purple River Chariot
resources.owner: Guanyin Bodhisattva (Purple River Chariot method) · a few senior immortals
resources.rarity_reason: Requires special refining · rare materials · only a few immortals know the formula
resources.effect: Life extension / qi replenishment · not top-tier but scarce
resources.chapter: Scattered in Daoist scriptures · an undercurrent in Xiyouji

resources.name: Nine-Turn Golden Elixir
resources.owner: Taishang Laojun (top grade of Tushita Palace)
resources.rarity_reason: Nine-turn refining · Laojun’s most supreme elixir · extremely scarce · used to revive the King of Wuji

resources.name: Taiyi Zhenren’s Lotus Avatar
resources.rarity_reason: Requires Taiyi Zhenren to personally cast the spell · lotus root as medium · remolds the body · extremely rare
resources.effect: Body remolding / resurrection · Nezha took this form after death

resource_stats.rarest_resource: Peach 9000-year tree (scarcity 10 · 9 trees in all · ripens every 9000 years)
resource_stats.most_efficient: Taishang Laojun’s Elixir / Nine-Turn Golden Elixir (efficacy 10 · instant immortality / resurrection)
resource_stats.hardest_access: Peach / Tang Sanzang’s Flesh / Golden Hoop Release / Nine-Turn Golden Elixir / Lotus Avatar (access_level 10 · extremely hard to obtain)
resource_stats.most_overhyped: Tang Sanzang’s Flesh (legendary immortality · but no demon actually succeeded · a ‘false resource’)

resource_insights: The 9000-year Peach is the scarcest (10) · the material basis of Heaven’s rule · controlling the peaches means controlling the immortals’ lifeline
Tang Sanzang’s Flesh — scarcity 10, yin and yang united · but its actual efficacy is doubtful · a ‘false resource’ · drives the main plot
Ginseng Fruit ripens every 3000 years · scarcity 9 · monopolized by Zhenyuan Daxian · the material basis of the loose immortals’ independence
Taishang Laojun’s elixir system (Elixir + Nine-Turn Golden Elixir) has the highest efficacy · the ‘instant immortality’ channel · held by the Daoist Patriarch
Golden Hoop Release is a ‘project reward’ resource · cannot be removed by external force · reveals Tathāgata’s logic of control over Wukong
Heavenly River Water is plentiful but only moderately effective · Zhu Bajie’s ‘hidden resource’ · not a top-tier immortality good
The Lotus Avatar is a ‘resurrection’ resource · exclusive to Nezha · reveals Taiyi Zhenren’s artifact-crafting skill
Purple River Chariot is an undercurrent resource · not the mainline but scarce · showing the immortality-resource system has a ‘gray area’
The 10 resources average scarcity 9.0 · average efficacy 8.8 · average access difficulty 9.5 · showing immortality is an extreme luxury
Heaven controls peaches + elixirs · Lingshan controls golden hoops · loose immortals control ginseng fruit · forming a ‘tripod’ immortality-resource pattern
